llm_history.content: Assalam o Alaikum sir. Kya main Ali Mobile Center ke owner se baat kar raha hoon
Mera naam Khizer hai aur main aapki Facebook page dekhi hai
Aapka online presence solid hai, lekin main curious hoon ke kya aapko isse steady flow of clients mil raha hai
Ya phir aapke local competitors aapke potential clients ko intercept kar rahe hain
Kyunke unke ads chal rahe hain aur wo market share le rahe hain
